feature.series: Integer in Focus, International Women in Engineering Day
feature.quote: I decided that I wanted to be a part of building a solution instead of prescribing it.
feature.photoAlt: Avery as a little girl in an oversized white lab coat, grinning beside an X-ray on a lightbox.

rows.value: Outdoors preferred. Performance improves noticeably after a bike ride.
Higher than I would like to admit. See OUTSIDE and GND for mitigation.
Buys project kits faster than she builds them.
Equally into cute things and The Matrix. Gets along with cats, plants, and anyone who will talk about either.

pins.label: VCC
pins.title: Runs on lattes
pins.text: Usually a latte, and whatever the seasonal one is. A hot Americano when it is a long day.
pins.caption: fuel

pins.label: OUTSIDE
pins.title: Plants and rivers
pins.text: Anywhere that is not a desk. I've canoed with Bengals in the Wild, a hiking club at LSU.
pins.alt: Avery smiling from a kayak on dark water at golden hour, another kayaker behind her.
pins.caption: river day

pins.label: SNOW
pins.title: Snowboarding
pins.text: Any chance I get, which in Louisiana is not many.
pins.alt: Avery as a kid, flat on her back in the snow in pink snow pants, her snowboard beside her.
pins.caption: snow, finally

pins.label: FIELD
pins.title: Soccer and softball
pins.text: Varsity soccer goalie and varsity softball in high school. At LSU, intramural flag football and softball until most of my team graduated.
pins.alt: Avery's intramural team in matching champions shirts on a lit softball field at night.
pins.caption: intramurals

pins.label: THRIFT
pins.title: Old things
pins.text: Thrift stores and flea markets, for the objects more than the clothes. Antiques, old cameras, anything with some history. I grew up going to flea markets with my grandparents on my dad's side, and that's where I found my folding bellows camera, the kind with a big round flash reflector for the bulb.
pins.caption: flea market find
pins.todo: TODO(ave): take a photo of the bellows camera for THRIFT.

pins.label: TYGA
pins.title: My cat
pins.text: Head of quality control. Supervises every project, contributes nothing to the commit history.
pins.alt: Tyga, a spotted cat with green eyes, sitting upright and looking straight at the camera.
pins.caption: Tyga, QC

pins.label: SIDEQ
pins.title: Side quests
pins.text: [LED music visualizers](/work/led-audio-spectrum/) for my sisters at Christmas. [A pool alarm](/work/acoustic-pool-alarm/) on my own time. A box of soldering kits I will absolutely build someday.
pins.alt: A 16 by 16 LED matrix lit up with an audio spectrum, columns of light rising from red at the bottom to white peaks.
pins.caption: side quest no. 1

pins.label: FILM
pins.title: Polaroids, everywhere
pins.text: I always have my Polaroid camera and a stack of film on me. I have a bad memory, so the prints are how I hold on to the good times with the people I love.
pins.alt: An instant print of Avery in her 2026 cap and gown holding her LSU diploma and sunflowers, cheek to cheek with her Grandma Joyce.
pins.caption: always loaded

pins.label: FAIRE
pins.title: Renaissance festivals
pins.text: Big fan. I go in costume, flower crown included.
pins.alt: Avery in a blue Renaissance dress and flower crown, lying in the woods at a festival with friends and her dad.
pins.caption: Ren Fair Day

extra.alt: Avery as a little girl in a pirate costume, frowning, next to her big brother Rickey holding a toy sword.
extra.caption: Started early.

pins.label: GND
pins.title: The levee
pins.text: Bike rides along the river. It is how I ground out after a long day, and sometimes there is a turtle on the slope.
pins.alt: A turtle in tall green grass.
pins.caption: turtle!
